title: Worktree Improvements
body:
Work trees shouldn't be shown as projects. in the project picker, they should appear on the worktree picker only.
We should also add some skills to the reference. We need a reference for how agents can pass all the settings we added to a repo. For example, I have a main repo and then I create a work tree. I would like the agent to know how to pass all the configuration, hidden files, pinned files, commands, and review layers to that work tree so I have the same setup. Then users can simply add that to their work tree or workflow, or even ask the agent later to do it for them.

title: Remote was stale after mac went to sleep
